verdict.rationale: Cal.com's docs mention connecting your calendars so people can book around your availability (cal-com-docs-16, cal-com-docs-28), implying calendar sync is core to the platform, but the evidence pack never details two-way busy-block sync across multiple work/personal calendars, conflict-checking logic, or write-back behavior. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-calendar busy-block overlay/sync, two-way write-back, and any hands-on confirmation that it keeps personal and work calendars in step.
